P (1) Turn ignition switch to LOCK.
(2) Disconnect negative (–) terminal cable from the
battery, and wait at least 90 seconds.
(3) Connect steering wheel pad connector.
(4) Connect negative (–) terminal cable to battery,
and wait at least 2 seconds.

C (1) Turn ignition switch to ACC or ON and wait at
least 20 seconds.
(2) Clear malfunction code stored in memory.
(See page RS–47)
(3) Turn ignition switch to LOCK, and wait at least
20 seconds.
(4) Turn ignition switch to ACC or ON, and wait at
least 20 seconds.
(5) Using SST, connect terminals Tc and E1 of
DLC1 or DLC2.
SST 09843–18020
(6) Check diagnostic trouble code.

OK Diagnostic trouble code 12 is not output.

Hint Codes other than code 12 may be output at this
time, but they are not relevant to this check.
